initialBase.head: 90cc92fb6f424eb6d9d0627b6977693ec1c641c2
initialBase.intent: Task 4: integration and delivery. Verify the already-merged backend and frontend end to end, add Dockerfile, .dockerignore, GitHub Actions CI, docs/coverage.md, final README, docs/ai/PROMPTS.md with the four original prompts, final docs/ai/WORKFLOW.md, and update shared docs (architecture, spec, AGENTS.md, ADRs) and documentation debt.

specification.goal: Make the repository ready to deliver: verify the merged tree end to end, add a Docker image, CI, a coverage report, the final README and the AI workflow documentation, fix the Go standard library vulnerabilities found in review by moving to Go 1.27.2, then commit and push.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend (gofmt -l, go vet, go test -count=1 -cover) and frontend (lint, typecheck, vitest run --coverage, build) checks pass on feat/delivery.
E2E smoke: backend on :8080 and Vite on :5173; curl directly and through the proxy; real outputs saved; all processes stopped afterwards.

Multi-stage Dockerfile (node:24.21.0-bookworm-slim, golang:1.27.2-bookworm, distroless static nonroot); .dockerignore excludes local state including **/.env and **/.env.*; Docker smoke builds, runs and curls /healthz, the API and /.
CI workflow (push and pull_request, contents read, concurrency, SHA-pinned actions, Go coverage thresholds, artifacts, docker build) passes actionlint; real CI is checked after the push.

backend/go.mod declares go 1.27.2 and the Dockerfile builds with golang:1.27.2-bookworm; govulncheck on backend/ reports no reachable vulnerability, or every remaining one is recorded as verified Vulnerabilidades debt. Debt vul-4fdf6bb3 is resolved when the scan is clean.
Docs cite Go 1.27.2 where they cite the exact version (spec.md, architecture.md, ADR 0004, backend/README.md) and coverage.md/README show the numbers observed with it.

Reviewer fixes: command blocks work when pasted from the repo root (README, coverage.md, architecture.md); the install-script claim mentions fsevents; README and AGENTS no longer say CI runs every check (govulncheck and npm audit are manual); WORKFLOW.md wording on parallel worktrees and STATIC_DIR listing corrected; missing static caching/compression recorded as suspected Rendimiento debt.

docs/coverage.md, final README, docs/ai/PROMPTS.md, final docs/ai/WORKFLOW.md and updated shared docs as approved before; no hand-maintained file exceeds 500 lines; git log --graph shows the foundation, the two parallel branches and their merges.
The work is committed on feat/delivery with Conventional Commits and pushed to origin (https://github.com/BillyJoe121/sezzle-calculator) after the user's explicit request.
preservedBehaviors: No Go or TypeScript application code changes; in backend/ only the go directive in go.mod changes.
Debt doc-1d33fb61, doc-b17a3c61, test-827d163b, test-d12065fc and test-c472d4d1 stay open.
No force-push, rebase, reset, stash, branch or worktree deletion.
decisions: User (2026-10-14): register the Go vulnerabilities, fix them with Go 1.27.2, stop the :8080 container, run the final checks, record remaining vulnerabilities as debt, apply the minor doc/config fixes, close in Forge, commit and push.
O2: soften the CI wording instead of adding govulncheck/npm audit jobs, so a future advisory does not turn the delivered CI red; both are documented as manual commands.
N1 (push and pull_request both trigger) kept: the evaluator sees CI on any pushed branch.

steps.title: Raise backend/go.mod and the Dockerfile builder to Go 1.27.2, update the version in the docs, rerun vet, tests and govulncheck; resolve vul-4fdf6bb3 or record what remains
Apply the reviewer's doc and config fixes (R2, O1, O2 wording, N2, N3, N4) and record O3 as suspected performance debt
Stop the :8080 container (user approved) and rerun every check: frontend, E2E, Docker, CI lint, git graph
Review, delivery, development check, ready, delivery question, commit, add origin and push

review.summary: Independent read-only review by forge-sonnet-max (previous chat): no Critical findings. R1 Go 1.27.0 stdlib vulnerabilities -> fixed (go 1.27.2, golang:1.27.2-bookworm; govulncheck v1.8.0 clean; vul-4fdf6bb3 resolved). R2 cd blocks failing from repo root -> fixed (cd ../frontend in README, coverage.md, architecture.md). R3 container on :8080 -> stopped with user approval. O1 fsevents install script -> wording fixed in Dockerfile and README. O2 CI does not run govulncheck/npm audit -> wording softened in README and AGENTS, both documented as manual (no new CI jobs so a future advisory does not break the delivered CI). O3 static caching/compression -> recorded as suspected performance debt perf-6385b81a. N1 duplicate push/PR runs -> kept on purpose. N2 .dockerignore -> **/.env and **/.env.*. N3, N4 WORKFLOW wording fixed. The coordinator reviewed the delta (go.mod directive, Dockerfile tag, docs) line by line. Residual risks: local vet ran with cmd/vet built from the 1.27.2 sources and local go test with -vet=off because Windows Application Control blocks the downloaded vet.exe; go test -race and the real GitHub Actions run are only verified after the push; the first e2e-smoke attempt timed out on a slow Edge start and passed on rerun (also passed locally in 21 s).

delivery.summary: Task 4 delivery: Docker image, CI, coverage report, final README, PROMPTS.md with the 4 prompts, final WORKFLOW.md and updated shared docs; Go raised to 1.27.2 to remove 6 reachable net/http vulnerabilities (govulncheck clean); reviewer fixes applied; 13 checks passed (go-fmt, go-vet, go-test, go-vuln, fe-lint, fe-typecheck, fe-test-coverage, fe-build, e2e-smoke, docker-smoke, ci-lint, line-limit, git-graph). Debt: resolved doc-9c4f7945 and vul-4fdf6bb3; created doc-cd1bf90f, test-73515323 and perf-6385b81a (suspected).

architecture.patterns: Multi-stage container build (Dockerfile: Node build -> Go static build -> distroless nonroot runtime) and a CI pipeline with SHA-pinned actions and fan-in (docker job needs backend and frontend) in .github/workflows/ci.yml.
architecture.flow: Delivery flow: one image serves the SPA from STATIC_DIR=/app/web and the API on :8080 (same origin, ADR 0006). CI: backend (gofmt, vet, test -race, coverage gates) and frontend (lint, typecheck, test, build) in parallel, then docker build.
architecture.contracts: sin cambios (docs/api untouched). Toolchain contract: backend/go.mod go 1.27.2 and golang:1.27.2-bookworm in the Dockerfile; setup-go reads go.mod.
architecture.state: sin cambios: the service stays stateless; coverage reports are CI artifacts, not committed.

evidenceBoundary: Read hashes and runner receipts are observed; goals and review prose are declared judgments.
